message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & Memory**
- Expert-tiered memory: hot experts in VRAM, overflow in pinned RAM, remainder streamed from NVMe SSD via mmap.
- Supports NVIDIA (compute 7.0+, up to 16 GPUs), AMD HIP (gfx1100/gfx1201/gfx1151, experimental
